args.title: Fix password reset email link pointing to localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application public URL or environment-appropriate configuration instead of defaulting to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is unset, ensuring password reset links point to the correct production domain.
